about_the_game:
Project Echo: Downfall is an atmospheric post-apocalyptic FPS with survival elements.

It has been 20 years since the catastrophe known as The Shift. The world is not just destroyed - it's distorted. Reality itself is unstable, survivors struggle against both the environment and each other, and the anomalies within the Downfall Zone grow more dangerous with each passing day.

Your only goal is to find the one you love.
But the deeper you venture into the Zone, the more your own memories begin to unravel.

FEATURES:

🌍 Open World Exploration - Explore the Downfall Zone, avoid deadly anomalies, and survive encounters with zombies and other stalkers.

⚙️ Survival & Crafting System - Gather resources, learn new recipes, craft supplies and equipment, and upgrade your shelter.

🔫 Wide Variety of Weapons - Fight using a broad range of weapons from melee tools like knives and makeshift gear to advanced weaponry such as laser guns and rocket launchers.

🤝 Barter System - Trade with other survivors to acquire the supplies you need.

🧠 Deep Narrative - Uncover the truth about the Downfall Zone and about yourself. Are your memories really your own?

📜 Quests & Activities - Complete a variety of missions and earn rewards while discovering more about the world and its inhabitants.

DEVELOPMENT:

The game is being developed by a small indie team. We regularly share development updates on our social media.

📢 Don't forget to join our Discord server
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel I5 4690 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 / RX 480 (4GB+ of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
